title: New project onboarding — user creates and understands project state
objective: Verify that a new user can onboard into a governed project: understand identity, view current state, identify required actions, and receive boundaries without needing external assistance.

source.description: Onboarding is the first user journey — a new participant must be able to understand project context from governed evidence

execution.criteria: User receives project identity, active contracts, current lifecycle state, and prohibited actions from the SDK evidence snapshot
execution.expected_outcome: User can describe project purpose, current phase, and boundary rules without accessing raw filesystem paths

pass_criteria.description: Project identity is accessible through SDK — not filesystem
Current lifecycle state is visible with phase and cursor position
evidence_required: Evidence provenance includes lifecycle cursor records

pass_criteria.description: User receives boundary information — what actions are prohibited
User does not need to read active/librarian/* paths directly
evidence_required: Knowledge adapter uses SDK as primary data source
